understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate each level’s grid to step onto and complete all goal cells. A goal can only be completed when the carried piece simultaneously matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation; finishing all goals advances to the next level, and finishing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (N/S/E/W) costs 1 stamina; if stamina reaches 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to max, and losing all lives ends the game. Movement is constrained by walls, provided each turn via blocked_directions (attempting a blocked direction wastes the move/stamina and doesn’t change position). Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape tiles cycle shapes 0–5 (wrap), color tiles cycle orange→blue→green→red→orange (wrap), and rotation tiles rotate 90° clockwise (0→90→180→270→0). A goal activates only when shape+color+rotation all match; stepping onto an activated goal completes it.
